dct_title_s: Points of Interest, San Joaquin County, California, 2020
dct_description_sm: This point shapefile contains points of interest in San Joaquin County, California. Points of interest included in this layer are schools, education centers, sports complexes, auditoriums, transit stations, zoos, churches, fire and police stations, cemetaries, hospitals, marinas, parks, golf courses, greenbelts, jails, libraries, museums, wineries and wasterwater treatment plants. Year: 2020.
